**4h**

It was my first time making a CAD for a team, a group with other people that will likely modify the CAD so I made sure to include a couple variables that controlled the LED spacing, etc. Also it was the first time I named all my CAD functions so neatly. ### 2026-10-18 – Consulted my build team and we decided that it was best to have the overall length around 8-9in, so i made it 8.5 inches. (Hate how inches always look terrible in mm). I also went through and modified

**2h**

Consulted my build team and we decided that it was best to have the overall length around 8-9in, so i made it 8.5 inches. (Hate how inches always look terrible in mm). I also went through and modified a couple other lengths, and made the top half filled in with print so it's more stable (plan is for it to survive a drop test!)
